summary.zh: 潜行更快、冷却更短，再加上让伏击暴击几率提高 45% 的强化伏击，多数目标一击掉半管血。
summary.en: Stealth that moves faster and returns sooner, plus a 45% critical strike chance on Ambush that takes half the health bar off most targets.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，从潜行开怪，并绕开不必打的战斗
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, opening from stealth and slipping past what you do not need to fight

pros.zh: 伪装让潜行的速度惩罚降低 9%、冷却缩短 4 秒，战斗间隙保持潜行变得现实。
pros.en: Camouflage reduces the Stealth speed penalty by 9% and its cooldown by 4 seconds, so staying stealthed between pulls is practical.

pros.zh: 强化伏击让伏击暴击几率提高 45%，伺机而动再让伏击、背刺、锁喉与毁伤伤害提高 10%。
pros.en: Improved Ambush adds 45% critical strike chance to Ambush, and Opportunity adds 10% damage to Ambush, Backstab, Garrote and Mutilate.

pros.zh: 鬼魅攻击在主手匕首时造成 180% 武器伤害，并在 7 秒内提高 15% 躲闪，且没有站位要求。
pros.en: Ghostly Strike deals 180% weapon damage with a dagger equipped, adds 15% dodge for 7 seconds, and has no positional requirement.

pros.zh: 调整偏向 PvP；打 PvE 时可以把这 2 点补满伪装，拿到完整的潜行移动速度。
pros.en: Setup leans towards PvP; in PvE those two points can finish Camouflage for the full stealth speed instead.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
